name: ISO Aret 20mg Softgel 10'S
description: Introduction About ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back. Take ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice. This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort. ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness. Uses Of ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age) Benefits of ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL for Acne: ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition. How ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL Works ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions. How to use ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL Take ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it. It is recommended to take the capsule with food to improve absorption and reduce stomach discomfort. Take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body. Follow the prescribed dosage and duration carefully. Do not stop the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if your symptoms improve. Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage. Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor. What if I Forget to take ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it. Overdosage of ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL – In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of ISO ARET 20MG SOFTGEL overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching. description: Introduction About BENCLEAR 5% GEL BENCLEAR 5% GEL contains Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-bacterial and Anti-inflammatory agents. It is used in the management of acne (pimples) in the face, chest and back. It is also used to unplug the blocked pores (blackheads and whiteheads) and absorb excess oil from the skin. Before using BENCLEAR 5% GEL, inform your doctor if you are having any allergy to foods, preservatives or dyes or if you are already under any medication for acne. It is not recommended to use hard cleansers, scrubs, medicated soap or cosmetic products containing alcohol while using this medicine. BENCLEAR 5% GEL is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly needed. Consult your doctor before using the medicine. Avoid repeated exposure to sunlight or other sources of UV light (such as sun bed). In case of accidental contact, rinse thoroughly with warm water and pat dry. Most common side effects of BENCLEAR 5% GEL are skin redness and irriation, burning, stinging sensation in the skin. Consult your doctor if any of above symptoms worsens. Uses Of BENCLEAR 5% GEL Used to: Manage acne (pimples) formation Remove excessive oil from the skin Unplug blocked pores How BENCLEAR 5% GEL Works BENCLEAR 5% GEL works against the acne-causing bacteria. This medicine after applying on the affected skin gets absorbed and is converted to benzoic acid. This benzoic acid gets metabolized by skin proteins and releases active free-radical oxygen species that results in the alteration of bacterial proteins. This helps to manage acne or pimples. BENCLEAR 5% GEL also acts as a keratolytic agent which promotes peeling of the skin and absorb excess oil from the skin further managing acne formation and skin irritation. How to use BENCLEAR 5% GEL Always apply BENCLEAR 5% GEL as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area as instructed by the doctor. Avoid contact with eyes, lips, mouth, nose, mucous membranes and sensitive areas of the neck. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending you’re your age, body weight and disease condition. Side Effects Of BENCLEAR 5% GEL Common Dry skin Skin redness Peeling of the skin Burning sensation of the skin Itching of the skin (pruritus) Pain of the skin (pain, stinging) Skin irritation Allergic contact dermatitis Rare Stop applying BENCLEAR 5% GEL and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects: Allergic reactions, including application site hypersensitivity, face swelling and anaphylaxis Severe skin irritation, redness and peeling of the skin, swelling of the face Fainting How To Manage Side Effects Skin rash: Avoid hot bath because hot water can irritate your skin further. Do not scratch the affected area. Use protective clothing when going outdoors. Regularly moisturize your skin and apply calamine lotion as a coolant. Consult your doctor if the symptoms persists for a long time. Warning & Precautions Pregnancy BENCLEAR 5% GEL is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using it. Breastfeeding BENCLEAR 5% GEL should be used with caution in breast feeding mothers. Consult your doctor before using the medicine. Allergy Do not apply BENCLEAR 5% GEL if you are allergic to Benzyl peroxide or to any other ingredients of this medicine. Others BENCLEAR 5% GEL is not recommended for use if you: Have damaged skin or broken skin Are using hard cleansers, scrubs, medicated soap or cosmetic products containing alcohol Use in paediatrics: Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before using BENCLEAR 5% GEL. Interactions A. Drug-Drug interactions: Before applying BENCLEAR 5% GEL, inform your doctor if you are taking or using any of the following medicine: Medicines used to manage various skin diseases (Ex. dapsone) Topical hydroquinone (medicine used to remove dark patches of the skin) Isotretinoin, topical tretinoin (used to manage acne) Topical anaesthetics (used to relieve pain and itching) Ex. benzocaine, lignocaine B. Drug-Food interactions: Before applying BENCLEAR 5% GEL inform your doctor if you are having any allergies to any other medicines, foods, preservatives or dyes. Overdosage: If you or anyone else accidentally applies more of BENCLEAR 5% GEL or accidently ingested BENCLEAR 5% GEL, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overuse of this medicine is severe skin irritation. BENCLEAR 5% GEL is used in the management of acne (pimples) in the face, chest and back. It can also be used to unplug the blocked pores (blackheads and whiteheads) and absorb excess oil from the skin. Consult your doctor before using BENCLEAR 5% GEL. How to use BENCLEAR 5% GEL? Always apply BENCLEAR 5% GEL as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash and dry your hands before applying this medicine. Wash the affected area with a mild cleanser and water and allow the skin to dry. Apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area leaving it for 2 hours and then wash it off with water and pat skin dry. What are the precautions to be followed while using BENCLEAR 5% GEL? While using BENCLEAR 5% GEL avoid contact with the eyes, lips, mouth, nose, mucous membranes and sensitive areas of the neck. In case of accidental contact rinse thoroughly with warm water and pat dry. You should not use any other acne products along with this medicine without taking advise from your doctor because they may cause skin to become red and sore. How long should I use BENCLEAR 5% GEL You should use BENCLEAR 5% GEL as long as advised by your physician or how quickly your condition improves. Sometimes acne may take time to clear completely. You should see your doctor if you feel your acne is not improving while using this medicine. Can BENCLEAR 5% GEL be used in pregnant women? BENCLEAR 5% GEL is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women or women who are planning to become pregnant unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using the medicine. Limit Exfoliation: Avoid physical or chemical exfoliants, as isotretinoin makes your skin more delicate and prone to irritation. Choose Gentle Fabrics: Wear soft, breathable fabrics like cotton to reduce friction and irritation on your dry skin. Seek Medical Advice: If dryness becomes severe or persistent despite home remedies, consult your doctor for additional treatment options or product recommendations. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy. Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation. It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it. Breastfeeding CONTRAINDICATED It is not known whether this medicine is excreted in human milk. Because of the potential for adverse effects, nursing mothers should not receive GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE Driving and Using Machines USE WITH CAUTION Do not drive or operate machinery if you experience dizziness, drowsiness or decreased night vision after taking GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE. Alcohol CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR Avoid consuming alcohol while taking GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE as it may increase side effects. Inform your doctor if you have an habit of chronic alcoholism. Kidney USE WITH CAUTION GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it. Liver CONTRAINDICATED GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it. Allergy CONTRAINDICATED Do not take GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Isotretinoin, soya, peanuts or any of the other ingredients of this medicine. Lungs USE WITH CAUTION GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients having asthma. Consult your doctor before taking it. The use of isotretinoin for severe recalcitrant nodular acne in adolescents ages 12 to 17 years under careful medical supervision. Extreme caution should be taken if the child is suffering from metabolic or structural bone disease. Use In Geriatrics CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR There is no proper information about the use of GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. Drink plenty of water to prevent dryness in your mouth and throat. Isotretinoin is related to vitamin A, so extra supplementation can cause toxicity. Avoid Excessive Sun Exposure: Wear sunscreen and protective clothing as isotretinoin can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight. Moisturize Regularly: Use lip balms and non-comedogenic moisturizers to manage dryness of lips and skin. Use Effective Birth Control: Isotretinoin can cause severe birth defects. Therefore, women must use reliable contraception as isotretinoin can cause severe birth defects. Do Not Donate Blood: Avoid donating blood while on isotretinoin and for at least a month after stopping it, as it can harm pregnant recipients. Alcohol can increase the risk of liver problems, so limit or avoid it. Notify your doctor about severe dryness, mood changes, or unusual symptoms. Interactions A. Drug-Drug interactions: Before taking GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: Vitamin A supplements Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. minocycline, doxycycline) Phenytoin (used to manage fits) Medicines used to manage various inflammatory conditions (Ex. betamethasone, prednisolone, dexamethasone) Medicines used to manage pregnancy (Ex. Norethindrone, ethinyl Oestradiol) St. John’s wort (herbal medicine used to manage mental disorders) Other medicines used to manage acne like keratolytic or exfoliative agents (Ex. salicylic acid, benzoyl peroxide) Synopsis Drug : Isotretinoin Pharmacological Category : Retinoids Therapeutic Indication : Severe acne Dosage Forms : Tablet, Soft gel Capsule, Capsule More Information Relevant Health Articles – Hormonal Acne: Causes, Symptoms, and Treatment Anti-Acne Food: Eat Healthy To Heal Acne -Infographic FAQs About GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE Q: What is GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE used for? A: GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE is used to manage severe acne (nodular or cystic acne) that does not respond to other treatments like antibiotics. It works by reducing oil production in the skin and preventing clogged pores. Q: How should I take GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE? A: Take GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE as prescribed by your doctor, usually once or twice daily with food. Swallow the capsule whole with water, and avoid breaking or crushing it. Follow your doctor’s instructions carefully for the best results. Q: What are the common side effects of GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE? A: Common side effects include dry skin, chapped lips, dry eyes, nosebleeds, and mild stomach discomfort. If you experience severe reactions like mood changes, persistent headaches, or vision problems, consult your doctor immediately. Q: Can GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE be taken during pregnancy? A: No, GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE should not be taken during pregnancy as it can cause severe birth defects. Women of childbearing age must use effective contraception during and at least one month after treatment. Q: Is GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE safe for long-term use? A: Isotretinoin is not usually prescribed for long-term use due to its potential side effects. Treatment duration is typically limited to 16–20 weeks. Always follow your doctor’s advice regarding treatment duration. Q: Can I use cosmetics while on GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE? A: Yes, you can use non-comedogenic and fragrance-free cosmetics. A: It is advised to avoid alcohol while taking GEONOIN 20MG CAPSULE, as it can increase the risk of liver damage and worsen side effects like dizziness or drowsiness. description: Introduction About BENZONIX GEL WASH [GBKEYWORD] contains Benzoyl peroxide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-bacterial and Anti-inflammatory agents. It is used to manage mild acne on face visible as whiteheads and blackheads on face as well as acne vulgaris (pimples occurring in the hair follicles). It is also used to manage formation of new blemishes on skin and unclog the pores of skin. BENZONIX GEL WASH is not recommended for severe acne and/or on the skin having deeper pits and dents, broken and/or damaged skin and in people who are allergic to benzoyl peroxide and/or any other ingredient found in BENZONIX GEL WASH. It is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless necessary. Consult your doctor before using BENZONIX GEL WASH. It is recommended to use only those products, that are labelled as non-comedogenic to manage clogging of pores. Avoid applying BENZONIX GEL WASH around your eyes, including eyelids and other mucous membranes. Also, care must be taken not to apply BENZONIX GEL WASH on broken/ damaged skin or the skin having dents or scars. Most common side effects of using BENZONIX GEL WASH are skin tension, burning stinging, itching, peeling and reddening of the skin. Consult your doctor if any of these above reactions bothers you. This medicine after applying on the affected skin gets absorbed and is converted to benzoic acid. This benzoic acid gets metabolized by skin proteins and releases active free-radical oxygen species that results in the alteration of bacterial proteins. This helps to manage acne or pimples. BENZONIX GEL WASH also acts as a keratolytic agent which promotes peeling of the skin and absorb excess oil from the skin further managing acne formation and skin irritation. How to use BENZONIX GEL WASH Always use BENZONIX GEL WASH as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your disease condition. Wet the area to be managed. Wash hands before use and place a small amount of BENZONIX GEL WASH on to the hands to wash the affected area. Wash and rinse thoroughly with water after application. Do not scratch the affected area. Use protective clothing when going outdoors. Regularly moisturize your skin and apply calamine lotion as a coolant. Consult your doctor if the symptoms persists for a long time. Warning & Precautions Pregnancy BENZONIX GEL WASH should be used with caution in pregnant women unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using the medicine. Breastfeeding BENZONIX GEL WASH is generally not recommended to be used in nursing women. Consult your doctor before using this medicine. Allergy Do not use BENZONIX GEL WASH if you are allergic to Benzyl peroxide or to any other ingredients of this medicine. Drug-Food interactions: Before applying BENZONIX GEL WASH inform your doctor if you are having any allergies to any other medicines, foods, preservatives or dyes. Overdosage: If you or anyone else accidentally uses too much of BENZONIX GEL WASH or accidentally ingested it, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. name: DERPALIN Gel 15gm
description: FAQs About DERPALIN GEL Q: Can DERPALIN GEL be used in the morning? A: Apply DERPALIN GEL as advised by your physician. It is best when applied at night and washed off in the morning since it is sensitive to sunlight. Consult your doctor for further queries. Q: Can DERPALIN GEL cause skin irritation? A: DERPALIN GEL may cause slight sensation of warmth and stinging after applying it for the initial 2-4 weeks. However, during the long-term usage this side effect usually disappears. Consult your doctor in case of any queries. Q: Can DERPALIN GEL be used daily? A: In many cases, DERPALIN GEL products are initially used once daily in the evening. However, some individuals may be advised to start with less frequent applications to allow the skin to adjust, and then gradually increase the frequency. Q: Can DERPALIN GEL make skin darker? A: DERPALIN GEL doesn’t make skin darker. Instead, it can slightly make the skin lighter by healing acne, pimples, blackheads and spots. Consult your doctor for further queries. Q: Can I go outside after applying DERPALIN GEL? A: No, avoid going out after applying DERPALIN GEL as it can cause local irritation and skin discomfort. It is best used at night. Consult the doctor for further assistance. Q: Can DERPALIN GEL be used for other skin conditions? A: DERPALIN GEL is primarily indicated for acne, but it may also be used off-label to manage other skin conditions such as keratosis pilaris (a common, harmless skin condition characterized by small, rough bumps on the skin). Q: Can DERPALIN GEL be used with other acne medications? A: It's generally not recommended to use DERPALIN GEL with other topical acne medications containing benzoyl peroxide, sulphur, resorcinol, or salicylic acid, as they may increase the risk of skin irritation. However, your healthcare provider may prescribe a combination regimen if deemed appropriate. Q: Can DERPALIN GEL be applied under makeup or moisturizers? A: Yes, DERPALIN GEL can be applied under makeup or moisturizers once it has been fully absorbed into the skin. It's important to allow the gel to dry completely before applying any other skincare products to avoid potential interactions or reduced effectiveness. Q: Can DERPALIN GEL be used for acne scars? A: DERPALIN GEL is primarily indicated for the management of acne lesions and may help improve the appearance of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation (dark spots) caused by acne. However, it may have limited efficacy in managing deeper acne scars or pitted scars. Consult your healthcare provider for more information. Q: Can DERPALIN GEL be used during pregnancy or breastfeeding? A: It's important to consult your healthcare provider before using DERPALIN GEL if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. While topical retinoids are generally considered safe during pregnancy, it's best to discuss the potential risks and benefits with your doctor. Author Details Written By Srilekha. name: CLINDASIL Gel 15gm
description: Introduction About CLINDASIL GEL CLINDASIL GEL is a combination of Clindamycin and Nicotinamide which belongs to a group of medicines called Lincomycin antibiotics and Vitamin B3 complex, respectively. CLINDASIL GEL is used to manage mild to moderate acne which is a skin condition that occurs when hair follicles become plugged with oil and dead skin cells which may occur due to variety of causes such as genetics, fluctuating hormone levels, stress, high humidity or using oily or greasy personal care products which may affect people of all ages. It is characterized by symptoms such as open or closed plugged pores, small red & tender bumps, pimples, large, solid or painful lumps under the skin and painful & pus-filled lumps under the skin. Before using CLINDASIL GEL inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, lung or heart diseases. Avoid applying CLINDASIL GEL to a cut, scrapped, sunburnt or eczema affected skin. CLINDASIL GEL should be used with caution in pregnant and in breastfeeding women. CLINDASIL GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before applying. The most common side effects of using CLINDASIL GEL are skin inflammation, contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash), inflammation of hair follicles, itchy skin, dry skin and peeling of skin. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen. Uses Of CLINDASIL GEL Manage mild to moderate acne How CLINDASIL GEL Works CLINDASIL GEL helps to manage acne, where Clindamycin reduces free fatty acid concentrations on the skin and suppresses the growth of Propionibacterium acnes (Corynebacterium acnes), a bacteria found in sebaceous glands and follicles and Nicotinamide exerts anti-inflammatory effect in acne and interrupts sebum production. How to use CLINDASIL GEL Apply CLINDASIL GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Before applying the medicine normally wash and dry the affected area and apply a thin layer of this medicine on the affected area. Managed areas on the face need not be covered with a plaster or bandage. Do not apply this medicine beyond the recommended duration. Avoid applying CLINDASIL GEL around your eyes, including eyelids. Rinse it off with water if you accidentally get it in these areas. Side Effects Of CLINDASIL GEL Common Contact dermatitis (red, itchy rash) Inflammation of hair follicles Itchy skin Dry skin Peeling of skin How To Manage Side Effects Skin rash/Itchy skin: Avoid hot bath because hot water can irritate your skin further. Do not scratch the affected area. Use protective clothing when going outdoors. Regularly moisturize your skin and apply calamine lotion as a coolant. Discuss with your doctor if the symptom worsens. Warning & Precautions Pregnancy CLINDASIL GEL should be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before applying. Breastfeeding CLINDASIL GEL should be used with caution in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before applying. Allergy CLINDASIL GEL is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Clindamycin, Nicotinamide or any other ingredients of this medicine. Others CLINDASIL GEL is not recommended for use if you have: Eczema (skin inflammation) Cut, scrapped, sunburnt skin Use in Pediatrics: CLINDASIL GEL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 12 years). Consult your doctor before using it for your child. Use in Geriatrics: There is no information on the use of CLINDASIL GEL in elderly patients. Consult with your doctor before using. Interactions A. name: Tufacne 10mg Capsule 10'S
description: Introduction About TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back. Take TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice. This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort. TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness. Uses Of TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age) Benefits of TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE for Acne: TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition. How TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE Works TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions. How to use TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE Take TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it. It is recommended to take the capsule with food to improve absorption and reduce stomach discomfort. Take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body. Follow the prescribed dosage and duration carefully. Do not stop the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if your symptoms improve. Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage. Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor. What if I Forget to take TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it. Overdosage of TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE – In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching. Side Effects Of TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE Like all medicines TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE may cause certain side effects, although not everyone gets them Common Side Effects of TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE: Dry skin More fragile and red skin than usual, especially of the face Back, muscle or joint pain (particularly in children and teenagers) Raised liver enzymes Changed blood fat and cholesterol levels Easy bruising, bleeding or clotting Headache Protein or blood in the urine Becoming more prone to get infections Sore or inflamed throat and nose Stop taking TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE and consult your doctor immediately in case you experience any of the following: Persistent pain in your lower back or buttocks (signs of sacroiliitis) Severe skin reactions (Ex. erythema multiforme, Stevens-Johnson Syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) (blistering and peeling of skin, severe rashes, fever, multiple lesions especially in mouth, nose, eyes and genitals, conjunctivitis, flu-like symptoms) Feeling depressed with suicidal thoughts Serious reactions (trouble breathing or swallowing due to sudden swelling of the throat, face, lips and mouth, sudden swelling of the hands, feet and ankles, hives, bruises, eczema, bruising, red patches on hands and legs) Rhabdomyolysis (muscle weakness along with trouble moving arms or legs, painful, swollen, bruised areas of the body, dark urine, reduced or no urination, confusion or dehydration) Hepatitis (yellow skin or eyes, tiredness) Kidney inflammation (difficulty urinating, swollen and puffy eyelids, excessive tiredness) How To Manage Side Effects Dry Skin Hydrate Regularly: Drink plenty of water throughout the day to keep your skin hydrated from within. Aim for at least 8–10 glasses daily. Use a Gentle Cleanser: Opt for a mild, fragrance-free cleanser to avoid further irritation. Avoid harsh soaps or scrubs that can strip the skin of natural oils. Moisturize Frequently: Apply a rich, non-comedogenic moisturizer to your face and body at least twice a day, especially after washing. Look for products with hydrating ingredients like hyaluronic acid or ceramides. Protect Your Lips: Use a moisturizing lip balm, preferably one with SPF, to prevent and treat cracked lips caused by dryness. Reapply as needed throughout the day. Avoid Long, Hot Showers: Hot water can strip your skin of its natural moisture. Take shorter showers with lukewarm water to minimize dryness. Humidify Your Environment: Use a humidifier in your home to add moisture to the air, especially during winter or in dry climates. Apply Sunscreen: Use a broad-spectrum sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher daily to protect your sensitive skin from sun damage and prevent further dryness. Limit Exfoliation: Avoid physical or chemical exfoliants, as isotretinoin makes your skin more delicate and prone to irritation. Choose Gentle Fabrics: Wear soft, breathable fabrics like cotton to reduce friction and irritation on your dry skin. Seek Medical Advice: If dryness becomes severe or persistent despite home remedies, consult your doctor for additional treatment options or product recommendations. Warning & Precautions Pregnancy CONTRAINDICATED Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy. Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation. It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it. Breastfeeding CONTRAINDICATED It is not known whether this medicine is excreted in human milk. Because of the potential for adverse effects, nursing mothers should not receive TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE Driving and Using Machines USE WITH CAUTION Do not drive or operate machinery if you experience dizziness, drowsiness or decreased night vision after taking TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE. Alcohol CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR Avoid consuming alcohol while taking TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE as it may increase side effects. Inform your doctor if you have an habit of chronic alcoholism. Kidney USE WITH CAUTION TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it. Liver CONTRAINDICATED TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it. Allergy CONTRAINDICATED Do not take TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Isotretinoin, soya, peanuts or any of the other ingredients of this medicine. Lungs USE WITH CAUTION TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients having asthma. Consult your doctor before taking it. Use In Pediatrics CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR The use of isotretinoin tablets in pediatric patients less than 12 years of age has not been studied. The use of isotretinoin for severe recalcitrant nodular acne in adolescents ages 12 to 17 years under careful medical supervision. Extreme caution should be taken if the child is suffering from metabolic or structural bone disease. Use In Geriatrics CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR There is no proper information about the use of TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. Others TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have: High blood fat levels High levels of Vitamin A Before taking TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you: Have or had mental illness or family history of mental illness such as depression, mood disorders, psychosis, aggressive behaviour, or hurting or killing self Have diabetes Are fructose intolerant Are overweight Safety Advice Always take isotretinoin with a meal to improve its absorption. Drink plenty of water to prevent dryness in your mouth and throat. Isotretinoin is related to vitamin A, so extra supplementation can cause toxicity. Avoid Excessive Sun Exposure: Wear sunscreen and protective clothing as isotretinoin can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight. Moisturize Regularly: Use lip balms and non-comedogenic moisturizers to manage dryness of lips and skin. Use Effective Birth Control: Isotretinoin can cause severe birth defects. Therefore, women must use reliable contraception as isotretinoin can cause severe birth defects. Do Not Donate Blood: Avoid donating blood while on isotretinoin and for at least a month after stopping it, as it can harm pregnant recipients. Follow Regular Check-Ups: Attend scheduled visits with your doctor for blood tests and monitoring. Avoid Waxing or Laser Treatments: Your skin is fragile during treatment and prone to scarring. Alcohol can increase the risk of liver problems, so limit or avoid it. Notify your doctor about severe dryness, mood changes, or unusual symptoms. Interactions A. Drug-Drug interactions: Before taking TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: Vitamin A supplements Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. minocycline, doxycycline) Phenytoin (used to manage fits) Medicines used to manage various inflammatory conditions (Ex. betamethasone, prednisolone, dexamethasone) Medicines used to manage pregnancy (Ex. Norethindrone, ethinyl Oestradiol) St. John’s wort (herbal medicine used to manage mental disorders) Other medicines used to manage acne like keratolytic or exfoliative agents (Ex. salicylic acid, benzoyl peroxide) Synopsis Drug : Isotretinoin Pharmacological Category : Retinoids Therapeutic Indication : Severe acne Dosage Forms : Tablet, Soft gel Capsule, Capsule More Information Relevant Health Articles – Hormonal Acne: Causes, Symptoms, and Treatment Anti-Acne Food: Eat Healthy To Heal Acne -Infographic FAQs About TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE Q: What is TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE used for? A: TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE is used to manage severe acne (nodular or cystic acne) that does not respond to other treatments like antibiotics. It works by reducing oil production in the skin and preventing clogged pores. Q: How should I take TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE? A: Take TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE as prescribed by your doctor, usually once or twice daily with food. Swallow the capsule whole with water, and avoid breaking or crushing it. Follow your doctor’s instructions carefully for the best results. Q: What are the common side effects of TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE? A: Common side effects include dry skin, chapped lips, dry eyes, nosebleeds, and mild stomach discomfort. If you experience severe reactions like mood changes, persistent headaches, or vision problems, consult your doctor immediately. Q: Can TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE be taken during pregnancy? A: No, TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE should not be taken during pregnancy as it can cause severe birth defects. Women of childbearing age must use effective contraception during and at least one month after treatment. Q: Is TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE safe for long-term use? A: Isotretinoin is not usually prescribed for long-term use due to its potential side effects. Treatment duration is typically limited to 16–20 weeks. Always follow your doctor’s advice regarding treatment duration. Q: Can I use cosmetics while on TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE? A: Yes, you can use non-comedogenic and fragrance-free cosmetics. Avoid abrasive cleansers, harsh exfoliants, or acne products containing benzoyl peroxide or salicylic acid, as these may irritate your skin. Q: Does TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE cause hair loss? A: Temporary hair thinning or hair loss can occur in some individuals during treatment. This side effect typically resolves after completing the course. If hair loss persists, consult your doctor. Q: Can I drink alcohol while taking TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE? A: It is advised to avoid alcohol while taking TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE, as it can increase the risk of liver damage and worsen side effects like dizziness or drowsiness. Q: How long does it take for TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE to work? A: You may start noticing improvements within 4–8 weeks, but the full effects are usually seen after completing the treatment course. Be patient and continue using the medicine as prescribed. Q: What precautions should I take while using TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE? A: Avoid excessive sun exposure and use sunscreen. Do not donate blood during and for one month after treatment. Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking. Use a reliable birth control to avoid becoming pregnant while taking TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE. Do not undergo cosmetic procedures such as skin waxing, dermabrasion, laser, or artificial UV light detanning while taking TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor. Q: Can TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE be used by men? A: Yes, TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE is safe for men to use for severe acne. However, male patients planning to father a child need not take special precautions, as isotretinoin does not affect sperm. Can TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE cause irregular periods? According to some studies, menstrual irregularity was observed during management follow-ups. Consult your doctor if you experience irregularity in your periods during management with TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE. Is TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE safe to take in pregnancy? No. TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and women planning a pregnancy. Inform your doctor if you become pregnant during management with TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE. It is not recommended to get pregnant for one month after stopping TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE management because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it. Contraception must be used for a month before taking TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE, during management and for a month afterwards. Discuss with your doctor regarding suitable contraceptive methods. Can I play sports during TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE management? Cut down on extreme exercise and physical activity as TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE can cause muscle and joint pain especially in children and teenagers taking up vigorous physical activity. Consult your doctor if you can play sports during this management. Can I go out in the sun during TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE management? Sensitivity to light may increase during management with TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE so, avoid going too much into the sun and don’t use a sun-lamp or sun-bed. Before you go out in the sun, wear sunglasses and use sunscreen with a high protection factor (SPF 15 or higher). Can undergo cosmetic procedures while taking TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE? No. Do not undergo cosmetic procedures such as skin waxing, dermabrasion, laser, or artificial UV light detanning while taking TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE or at least for 6 months after stopping it as they could cause scarring, skin irritation, or changes in your skin colour. Consult your doctor before undergoing any cosmetic procedure while taking TUFACNE 10MG CAPSULE. References 1. KD Tripathi. Drugs Acting on Skin and Mucous Membranes. name: CLENZ AC Gel 15g
description: Introduction About CLENZ AC GEL Clenz AC gel is an acne medication used to manage existing acne and prevent further acne breakouts. It contains a combination of two active ingredients namely Clindamycin and Benzoyl peroxide which acts by stopping the growth and multiplication of the acne-causing bacteria. Additionally, benzoyl peroxide can remove the accumulated dead skin cells and excess oil from the skin pores that triggers acne breakouts. Clenz AC is suitable for use in adults and in adolescents (aged 12 years or older). Use Clenz AC gel as directed by the physician. It is for external use only. Avoid using Clenz AC gel on inflamed, irritated, or sensitive skin areas. Before using Clenz AC gel inform your doctor if you have recently used any medicine that contains clindamycin or erythromycin. You must also inform your doctor if you have any problems in your gut (ulcerative colitis) or are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution. Clenz AC gel may cause skin redness and peeling in some individuals during the first few weeks of therapy. If you experience this, stop using Clenz AC gel for a short period until your skin recovers. However, consult your doctor immediately if your skin irritation becomes severe and accompanied with skin redness, dryness, itching, stinging, or burning sensation. Uses Of CLENZ AC GEL Manages mild to moderate acne vulgaris Reduces inflammation and bacterial growth on the skin Helps in controlling excess oil production and prevents clogged pores Supports skin barrier repair and reduces post-acne marks Who Should Use CLENZ AC Gel? People with Mild to Moderate Acne – Helps clear pimples, whiteheads, blackheads, and prevent new breakouts. Oily & Acne-Prone Skin Types – Controls excess oil and unclogs pores for smoother skin. Teenagers & Adults with Acne Issues – Suitable for those struggling with acne due to hormonal changes, stress, or environmental factors. Benefits of CLENZ AC GEL Manages Acne & Pimples: CLENZ AC Gel effectively combats acne-causing bacteria (Propionibacterium acnes), reducing breakouts and preventing future pimples. Reduces Redness & Inflammation – Clenz AC contains Clindamycin, a potent antibiotic that helps calm skin irritation, swelling, and redness associated with acne. Controls Excess Oil & Sebum Production – The Benzoyl peroxide present in the gel helps regulate oil secretion, preventing clogged pores and reducing the chances of new acne formation. Unclogs Pores & Prevents Blackheads – The gel penetrates deep into the skin to clear pores, reducing blackheads, whiteheads, and acne recurrence. Lightweight & Non-Greasy Formula – Easily absorbed by the skin, CLENZ AC Gel provides effective acne therapy without leaving a sticky or oily residue. Suitable for Oily & Acne-Prone Skin – Dermatologically tested formula that works best for individuals with mild to moderate acne, oily skin, and combination skin types. How CLENZ AC GEL Works CLENZ AC Gel is a powerful acne-fighting gel that works in two ways to give you clearer, healthier skin: Kills Acne-Causing Bacteria – It contains Clindamycin, an antibiotic that targets and eliminates bacteria responsible for acne breakouts, reducing infection and swelling. Unclogs Pores & Removes Excess Oil – Benzoyl Peroxide works as an exfoliant, removing dead skin cells, unclogging pores, and controlling excess oil, preventing new breakouts. Together, these ingredients help manage existing acne, prevent future breakouts, and improve skin texture, leaving you with clearer, healthier skin. How to use CLENZ AC GEL How to Use CLENZ AC Gel? Wash your face with a mild cleanser and pat it dry. Take a small amount of CLENZ AC Gel and apply it evenly to the affected areas. Apply as directed by your dermatologist, usually once at night or twice a day. Keep the gel away from your eyes, mouth, and broken skin. Benzoyl peroxide can make your skin sensitive to sunlight, so apply sunscreen during the day. Overdose Since CLENZ AC Gel is for external use only, an overdose is unlikely. However, applying too much gel or using it too frequently can cause: Severe skin irritation – Redness, burning, peeling, or excessive dryness. Increased sensitivity – Skin may become more prone to sunburn. Excessive peeling – Overuse may strip natural oils, leading to flaking or discomfort. What to Do If You Overapply? Wash off excess gel with mild water and avoid reapplying immediately. Use a moisturizer to soothe irritation. Skip the next application if your skin feels too sensitive. Consult a doctor if you experience severe burning, swelling, or blisters. Accidental Ingestion? CLENZ AC Gel is not meant to be swallowed. If ingested, seek medical help immediately. Side Effects Of CLENZ AC GEL Like all medicines, Clenz AC gel may cause certain side effects in some individuals, although not everyone gets them. Some of the Common Side Effects of Clenz AC Gel are: Skin redness, irritation, itching, burning or stinging sensation at the site of application Skin dryness, peeling of the skin, sensitivity to sunlight Headache When To Seek Medical Attention? Stop using Clenz AC gel and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects: Signs of allergic reactions (such as swelling of your face, eyes, lips, tongue, or throat, trouble breathing, nettle rash, severe dizziness, collapse) Severe or prolonged diarrhea with stomach cramps Severe itching, or burning or peeling of the skin How To Manage Side Effects Skin Conditions Use a Gentle Moisturizer – Apply a non-comedogenic (oil-free) moisturizer to hydrate and soothe your skin. Apply Less Product – Start with a small amount and apply only once a day until your skin adjusts. Avoid Harsh Skincare Products – Do not use scrubs, alcohol-based toners, or exfoliants while using CLENZ AC Gel. Use Sunscreen Daily – Benzoyl peroxide can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so always wear sunscreen (SPF 30+). Skip a Dose If Needed – If irritation is severe, reduce application to every other day or as directed by your doctor. Consult Your Dermatologist – If you develop severe burning, swelling, or blistering, stop using the gel and seek medical advice. Warning & Precautions Pregnancy CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR There are only limited data regarding the use of Clenz AC gel in pregnant women. Therefore, consult your doctor before using Clenz AC gel if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant. Your doctor may prescribe you with Clenz AC gel based on the risk and benefit ratio. Breastfeeding CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR There are only limited data regarding the use of Clenz AC gel in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before using. Allergy CONTRAINDICATED Do not use Clenz AC gel if you are allergic to Clindamycin, Benzoyl peroxide or lincomycin. Use In Pediatrics CONTRAINDICATED Clenz AC gel should not be used in children and in adolescents (aged 18 years or older) only if prescribed by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it. Use In Geriatrics USE WITH CAUTION Clenz AC gel should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it. Other Warnings for CLENZ AC GEL Before using Clenz AC gel inform your doctor if you: Have any skin inflammation, irritation, or photosensitivity Have problems in the gut (such as regional enteritis, ulcerative colitis or stomach inflammation caused due to use of antibiotics) Have recently used any medicine that contains clindamycin or erythromycin in it Have an upcoming surgery Drug - Drug interaction Before using Clenz AC gel inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following: Other medicines used for acne (such as tretinoin, isotretinoin or tazarotene) Erythromycin, sulfacetamide (medicines used to manage bacterial infections) Dapsone (a medicine used to manage leprosy) General anesthetics (used for relaxing skeletal muscles before surgery) Ex. pancuronium, vercuronium Medicated or abrasive soaps and cleansers Products contain large amounts of alcohol or astringents (Ex. skin cleansers or toners) More Information Storage Keep Clenz AC gel out of reach of children Store Clenz AC gel in a cool, dry place or in a refrigerator depending upon the instructions mentioned in the label Avoid contact of Clenz AC gel with eyes, ears, nose, or mouth. If contact happens accidentally, rinse it off with warm water Avoid contact of Clenz AC gel with coloured fabrics, including clothing, towels, bed linen, furniture or carpeting as it may bleach them FAQs About CLENZ AC GEL Q: What is Clenz AC gel used for? A: CLENZ AC Gel is a topical acne therapy that helps reduce and prevent pimples, whiteheads, and blackheads. It contains Clindamycin (an antibiotic) and Benzoyl Peroxide (a powerful exfoliant and antibacterial agent), which work together to kill acne-causing bacteria, unclog pores, and control excess oil. This gel is recommended for mild to moderate acne and helps improve overall skin texture. Q: How does CLENZ AC Gel work for acne? A: CLENZ AC Gel works through a dual-action formula: Clindamycin – An antibiotic that kills Propionibacterium acnes, the bacteria responsible for acne breakouts. It also reduces redness and swelling. Benzoyl Peroxide – A keratolytic agent that removes dead skin cells, unclogs pores, and reduces oiliness. It also has antibacterial properties that prevent new pimples from forming. By combining these effects, CLENZ AC Gel manages existing acne, prevents future breakouts, and promotes smoother, clearer skin. Q: Is CLENZ AC Gel safe? A: Yes, CLENZ AC Gel is generally safe for most people when used as directed. However, some individuals may experience mild skin irritation, dryness, redness, or peeling, especially in the first few weeks of use. To minimize side effects, apply a thin layer once daily and gradually increase frequency if needed. Use a gentle moisturizer to prevent excessive dryness. Apply sunscreen (SPF 30+) daily, as Benzoyl Peroxide increases sun sensitivity. Avoid using harsh exfoliants or alcohol-based products alongside this gel. If you experience severe irritation, swelling, or blistering, discontinue use and consult a dermatologist. Q: How to use CLENZ AC Gel for pimples? A: Wash your face with a mild cleanser and pat dry. Apply a thin layer of CLENZ AC Gel only to the affected areas. Avoid the eyes, nostrils, and mouth. Use once daily at night, or as directed by your doctor. If your skin tolerates it well, you may increase usage to twice daily. Moisturize your skin to prevent excessive dryness. Apply sunscreen during the day, as acne treatments can increase sun sensitivity. Q: Is CLENZ AC Gel good for oily skin? A: Yes! CLENZ AC Gel is highly effective for oily and acne-prone skin because, benzoyl Peroxide controls excess oil production and prevents clogged pores. Clindamycin reduces bacterial growth, minimizing the chances of breakouts. The gel-based formula is lightweight, non-greasy, and absorbs quickly without making the skin feel sticky. However, if your skin becomes too dry, using a lightweight, oil-free moisturizer can help maintain balance. Q: Does CLENZ AC Gel remove acne scars? A: CLENZ AC Gel primarily manages active acne but may also help fade mild acne marks over time by reducing inflammation and promoting skin renewal. However, for deep or stubborn acne scars, additional treatments like retinoids, chemical peels, or laser therapy may be needed. Use a broad-spectrum sunscreen daily to prevent acne scars from darkening due to sun exposure. Q: Can I use CLENZ AC Gel daily? A: Yes, CLENZ AC Gel can be used daily, but it’s best to start with once-daily application at night. If your skin tolerates it well, you can increase to twice daily. If irritation occurs, reduce frequency or apply it every other day. Always follow up with a moisturizer to prevent dryness. Avoid excessive sun exposure and use SPF 30+ sunscreen during the day. Q: Can CLENZ AC Gel be used during pregnancy? A: CLENZ AC Gel is not typically recommended during pregnancy unless prescribed by a doctor. Limited studies exist on its safety in pregnancy, so it’s best to consult a doctor before use. If you're pregnant or planning to conceive, speak with your doctor about safer alternatives like azelaic acid or pregnancy-safe skincare products. description: Introduction About ISAC 20MG CAPSULE ISAC 20MG CAPSULE contains Isotretinoin, a retinoid medication specifically designed to manage severe acne in adults and children over 12 years of age. It is particularly effective for nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring when other anti-acne treatments have failed. Acne is a skin condition characterized by inflammatory spots, oily skin, and painful nodular lesions that commonly affect the face, chest, and back. Take ISAC 20MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor, following the recommended dose and duration. It is best taken with food, preferably at the same time each day, to reduce the chances of missing a dose. It may take a few weeks before you notice an improvement in your symptoms but continue taking the medication as directed to achieve optimal results. If your condition does not improve after several weeks, consult your doctor for further advice. This medication can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight, so limit sun exposure and use sunscreen when outdoors. It may also make your skin more fragile, so avoid waxing or laser treatments during therapy. Dryness of the lips, mouth, and eyes is another potential side effect—stay hydrated and use moisturizers or lubricating eye drops as needed Common side effects include dry skin, rashes, and elevated liver enzymes. While these are generally mild and tend to subside as your body adjusts to the medication, inform your doctor if they persist or cause discomfort. ISAC 20MG CAPSULE is known to cause birth defects, so it should not be used during pregnancy or if you are planning to conceive. Always discuss your treatment plan with your doctor to ensure safety and effectiveness. Uses Of ISAC 20MG CAPSULE Severe acne in adults and children (older than 12 years of age) Benefits of ISAC 20MG CAPSULE for Acne: ISAC 20MG CAPSULE is highly effective in managing severe acne conditions such as nodular acne, conglobate acne, and acne prone to permanent scarring. It works by reducing the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, unclogging pores, and decreasing inflammation, which helps to clear up existing acne and prevent new breakouts. This leads to smoother, healthier skin and reduces the risk of long-term scarring. Additionally, it targets the underlying causes of severe acne, making it a reliable choice for those who have not responded to other treatments. Always consult your doctor to ensure it is suitable for your condition. How ISAC 20MG CAPSULE Works ISAC 20MG CAPSULE work by targeting the root causes of severe acne. They reduce the production of excess oil (sebum) in the skin, which helps prevent pores from becoming clogged. This, in turn, reduces the growth of acne-causing bacteria and inflammation. Isotretinoin also promotes the turnover of skin cells, preventing the formation of new acne lesions. Together, these actions help clear up existing acne and reduce the chances of scarring, making it an effective treatment for stubborn or severe acne conditions. How to use ISAC 20MG CAPSULE Take ISAC 20MG CAPSULE exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Swallow the capsule whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew it. It is recommended to take the capsule with food to improve absorption and reduce stomach discomfort. Take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body. Follow the prescribed dosage and duration carefully. Do not stop the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, even if your symptoms improve. Regular follow-ups and blood tests may be required to monitor your progress and ensure safe usage. Avoid alcohol, excessive sun exposure, and waxing or laser treatments during the treatment period. Use sunscreen and moisturizers as recommended by your doctor. What if I Forget to take ISAC 20MG CAPSULE: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next dose, skip the missed dose—do not double the dose to make up for it. Overdosage of ISAC 20MG CAPSULE – In case you or anybody else accidently take too much of ISAC 20MG CAPSULE, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of ISAC 20MG CAPSULE overdose are severe headache, abdominal pain, nausea, dizziness, redness of face, vomiting, somnolence, irritability, and itching. Side Effects Of ISAC 20MG CAPSULE Like all medicines ISAC 20MG CAPSULE may cause certain side effects, although not everyone gets them Common Side Effects of ISAC 20MG CAPSULE: Dry skin More fragile and red skin than usual, especially of the face Back, muscle or joint pain (particularly in children and teenagers) Raised liver enzymes Changed blood fat and cholesterol levels Easy bruising, bleeding or clotting Headache Protein or blood in the urine Becoming more prone to get infections Sore or inflamed throat and nose Stop taking ISAC 20MG CAPSULE and consult your doctor immediately in case you experience any of the following: Persistent pain in your lower back or buttocks (signs of sacroiliitis) Severe skin reactions (Ex. erythema multiforme, Stevens-Johnson Syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis) (blistering and peeling of skin, severe rashes, fever, multiple lesions especially in mouth, nose, eyes and genitals, conjunctivitis, flu-like symptoms) Feeling depressed with suicidal thoughts Serious reactions (trouble breathing or swallowing due to sudden swelling of the throat, face, lips and mouth, sudden swelling of the hands, feet and ankles, hives, bruises, eczema, bruising, red patches on hands and legs) Rhabdomyolysis (muscle weakness along with trouble moving arms or legs, painful, swollen, bruised areas of the body, dark urine, reduced or no urination, confusion or dehydration) Hepatitis (yellow skin or eyes, tiredness) Kidney inflammation (difficulty urinating, swollen and puffy eyelids, excessive tiredness) How To Manage Side Effects Dry Skin Hydrate Regularly: Drink plenty of water throughout the day to keep your skin hydrated from within. Aim for at least 8–10 glasses daily. Use a Gentle Cleanser: Opt for a mild, fragrance-free cleanser to avoid further irritation. Avoid harsh soaps or scrubs that can strip the skin of natural oils. Moisturize Frequently: Apply a rich, non-comedogenic moisturizer to your face and body at least twice a day, especially after washing. Look for products with hydrating ingredients like hyaluronic acid or ceramides. Protect Your Lips: Use a moisturizing lip balm, preferably one with SPF, to prevent and treat cracked lips caused by dryness. Reapply as needed throughout the day. Avoid Long, Hot Showers: Hot water can strip your skin of its natural moisture. Take shorter showers with lukewarm water to minimize dryness. Humidify Your Environment: Use a humidifier in your home to add moisture to the air, especially during winter or in dry climates. Apply Sunscreen: Use a broad-spectrum sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher daily to protect your sensitive skin from sun damage and prevent further dryness. Limit Exfoliation: Avoid physical or chemical exfoliants, as isotretinoin makes your skin more delicate and prone to irritation. Choose Gentle Fabrics: Wear soft, breathable fabrics like cotton to reduce friction and irritation on your dry skin. Seek Medical Advice: If dryness becomes severe or persistent despite home remedies, consult your doctor for additional treatment options or product recommendations. Warning & Precautions Pregnancy CONTRAINDICATED Human and animal studies have shown that isotretinoin is teratogenic in nature. Birth defects such as abnormalities of the face, eyes, ears, skull, central nervous system, cardiovascular system, and thymus and parathyroid glands or IQ less than score of 85 have been reported in female patients who were pregnant or became pregnant while on therapy with isotretinoin. Therefore, ISAC 20MG CAPSULE is considered unsafe for use during pregnancy. Women of childbearing potential must use a reliable contraceptive method to avoid becoming pregnant. If you accidentally became pregnant while taking this medicine, stop taking it and consult your gynaecologist for further evaluation. It is also not recommended for you to get pregnant for one month after stopping isotretinoin tablets because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it. Breastfeeding CONTRAINDICATED It is not known whether this medicine is excreted in human milk. Because of the potential for adverse effects, nursing mothers should not receive ISAC 20MG CAPSULE Driving and Using Machines USE WITH CAUTION Do not drive or operate machinery if you experience dizziness, drowsiness or decreased night vision after taking ISAC 20MG CAPSULE. Alcohol CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR Avoid consuming alcohol while taking ISAC 20MG CAPSULE as it may increase side effects. Inform your doctor if you have an habit of chronic alcoholism. Kidney USE WITH CAUTION ISAC 20MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it. Liver CONTRAINDICATED ISAC 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it. Allergy CONTRAINDICATED Do not take ISAC 20MG CAPSULE if you are allergic to Isotretinoin, soya, peanuts or any of the other ingredients of this medicine. Lungs USE WITH CAUTION ISAC 20MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in patients having asthma. Consult your doctor before taking it. Use In Pediatrics CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR The use of isotretinoin tablets in pediatric patients less than 12 years of age has not been studied. The use of isotretinoin for severe recalcitrant nodular acne in adolescents ages 12 to 17 years under careful medical supervision. Extreme caution should be taken if the child is suffering from metabolic or structural bone disease. Use In Geriatrics CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR There is no proper information about the use of ISAC 20MG CAPSULE in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. Others ISAC 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use if you have: High blood fat levels High levels of Vitamin A Before taking ISAC 20MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you: Have or had mental illness or family history of mental illness such as depression, mood disorders, psychosis, aggressive behaviour, or hurting or killing self Have diabetes Are fructose intolerant Are overweight Safety Advice Always take isotretinoin with a meal to improve its absorption. Drink plenty of water to prevent dryness in your mouth and throat. Isotretinoin is related to vitamin A, so extra supplementation can cause toxicity. Avoid Excessive Sun Exposure: Wear sunscreen and protective clothing as isotretinoin can make your skin more sensitive to sunlight. Moisturize Regularly: Use lip balms and non-comedogenic moisturizers to manage dryness of lips and skin. Use Effective Birth Control: Isotretinoin can cause severe birth defects. Therefore, women must use reliable contraception as isotretinoin can cause severe birth defects. Do Not Donate Blood: Avoid donating blood while on isotretinoin and for at least a month after stopping it, as it can harm pregnant recipients. Follow Regular Check-Ups: Attend scheduled visits with your doctor for blood tests and monitoring. Avoid Waxing or Laser Treatments: Your skin is fragile during treatment and prone to scarring. Alcohol can increase the risk of liver problems, so limit or avoid it. Notify your doctor about severe dryness, mood changes, or unusual symptoms. Interactions A. Drug-Drug interactions: Before taking ISAC 20MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: Vitamin A supplements Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. minocycline, doxycycline) Phenytoin (used to manage fits) Medicines used to manage various inflammatory conditions (Ex. betamethasone, prednisolone, dexamethasone) Medicines used to manage pregnancy (Ex. Norethindrone, ethinyl Oestradiol) St. John’s wort (herbal medicine used to manage mental disorders) Other medicines used to manage acne like keratolytic or exfoliative agents (Ex. salicylic acid, benzoyl peroxide) Synopsis Drug : Isotretinoin Pharmacological Category : Retinoids Therapeutic Indication : Severe acne Dosage Forms : Tablet, Soft gel Capsule, Capsule More Information Relevant Health Articles – Hormonal Acne: Causes, Symptoms, and Treatment Anti-Acne Food: Eat Healthy To Heal Acne -Infographic FAQs About ISAC 20MG CAPSULE Q: What is ISAC 20MG CAPSULE used for? A: ISAC 20MG CAPSULE is used to manage severe acne (nodular or cystic acne) that does not respond to other treatments like antibiotics. It works by reducing oil production in the skin and preventing clogged pores. Q: How should I take ISAC 20MG CAPSULE? A: Take ISAC 20MG CAPSULE as prescribed by your doctor, usually once or twice daily with food. Swallow the capsule whole with water, and avoid breaking or crushing it. Follow your doctor’s instructions carefully for the best results. Q: What are the common side effects of ISAC 20MG CAPSULE? A: Common side effects include dry skin, chapped lips, dry eyes, nosebleeds, and mild stomach discomfort. If you experience severe reactions like mood changes, persistent headaches, or vision problems, consult your doctor immediately. Q: Can ISAC 20MG CAPSULE be taken during pregnancy? A: No, ISAC 20MG CAPSULE should not be taken during pregnancy as it can cause severe birth defects. Women of childbearing age must use effective contraception during and at least one month after treatment. Q: Is ISAC 20MG CAPSULE safe for long-term use? A: Isotretinoin is not usually prescribed for long-term use due to its potential side effects. Treatment duration is typically limited to 16–20 weeks. Always follow your doctor’s advice regarding treatment duration. Q: Can I use cosmetics while on ISAC 20MG CAPSULE? A: Yes, you can use non-comedogenic and fragrance-free cosmetics. Avoid abrasive cleansers, harsh exfoliants, or acne products containing benzoyl peroxide or salicylic acid, as these may irritate your skin. Q: Does ISAC 20MG CAPSULE cause hair loss? A: Temporary hair thinning or hair loss can occur in some individuals during treatment. This side effect typically resolves after completing the course. If hair loss persists, consult your doctor. Q: Can I drink alcohol while taking ISAC 20MG CAPSULE? A: It is advised to avoid alcohol while taking ISAC 20MG CAPSULE, as it can increase the risk of liver damage and worsen side effects like dizziness or drowsiness. Q: How long does it take for ISAC 20MG CAPSULE to work? A: You may start noticing improvements within 4–8 weeks, but the full effects are usually seen after completing the treatment course. Be patient and continue using the medicine as prescribed. Q: What precautions should I take while using ISAC 20MG CAPSULE? A: Avoid excessive sun exposure and use sunscreen. Do not donate blood during and for one month after treatment. Inform your doctor about any other medications or supplements you are taking. Use a reliable birth control to avoid becoming pregnant while taking ISAC 20MG CAPSULE. Do not undergo cosmetic procedures such as skin waxing, dermabrasion, laser, or artificial UV light detanning while taking ISAC 20MG CAPSULE without consulting your doctor. Q: Can ISAC 20MG CAPSULE be used by men? A: Yes, ISAC 20MG CAPSULE is safe for men to use for severe acne. However, male patients planning to father a child need not take special precautions, as isotretinoin does not affect sperm. Can ISAC 20MG CAPSULE cause irregular periods? According to some studies, menstrual irregularity was observed during management follow-ups. Consult your doctor if you experience irregularity in your periods during management with ISAC 20MG CAPSULE. Is ISAC 20MG CAPSULE safe to take in pregnancy? No. ISAC 20MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women and women planning a pregnancy. Inform your doctor if you become pregnant during management with ISAC 20MG CAPSULE. It is not recommended to get pregnant for one month after stopping ISAC 20MG CAPSULE management because some medicine may still be left in your body. Consult your doctor before taking it. Contraception must be used for a month before taking ISAC 20MG CAPSULE, during management and for a month afterwards. Discuss with your doctor regarding suitable contraceptive methods. Can I play sports during ISAC 20MG CAPSULE management? Cut down on extreme exercise and physical activity as ISAC 20MG CAPSULE can cause muscle and joint pain especially in children and teenagers taking up vigorous physical activity. Consult your doctor if you can play sports during this management. Can I go out in the sun during ISAC 20MG CAPSULE management? Sensitivity to light may increase during management with ISAC 20MG CAPSULE so, avoid going too much into the sun and don’t use a sun-lamp or sun-bed. Before you go out in the sun, wear sunglasses and use sunscreen with a high protection factor (SPF 15 or higher). Can undergo cosmetic procedures while taking ISAC 20MG CAPSULE? No. Do not undergo cosmetic procedures such as skin waxing, dermabrasion, laser, or artificial UV light detanning while taking ISAC 20MG CAPSULE or at least for 6 months after stopping it as they could cause scarring, skin irritation, or changes in your skin colour.
